name: Darcy Fadel
episode: The worker who couldn't read the joke
life: “I still remember laughing at a break-room story a moment too late.” People around Juniper Street know Darcy by a small Thursday habit. Darcy knows which of the west-side porches has a seat in the shade.
voice: I laughed because my boss looked right at me. I want the people who saw the picture to know that.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a soft blue checked shirt and a fabric zip pull cut from a school scarf. Darcy has a crooked front tooth visible when laughing, with short copper curls. Darcy gives a little nod before asking a hard question during a conversation.
personality: Darcy finds names easy and faces hard on a crowded street. People who assume they have been snubbed usually get a warmer greeting once they speak.
agenda: To tell the crew what the laugh actually meant.
family: Franklin Pike is Darcy’s half-sibling. Darcy sets the time to leave. Franklin picks the meeting place. It lets them stay close without turning a family visit into the loss of an entire day. They have both had stretches when that distinction mattered. Asked about *The upstairs lease*, Franklin says, “I offered boxes and got asked to be a witness at the lease meeting.”
connections: Olivia Nielsen (bilingual colleague). A truthful translation gives the photographed worker the words to challenge the apparent laugh.

reactions.situation: A manager wants the photographed worker to address the crew
reactions.response: Darcy offers the pictured worker a private conversation before any meeting with the crew.
reactions.asWritten: A manager wants the photographed worker to address the crew. Darcy offers the pictured worker a private conversation before any meeting with the crew.

reactions.situation: An unfamiliar person asks for directions but cannot read the street signs
reactions.response: Darcy finds out what the destination actually looks like to the traveler and gives directions in those terms.
reactions.asWritten: An unfamiliar person asks for directions but cannot read the street signs. Darcy finds out what the destination actually looks like to the traveler and gives directions in those terms.

reactions.situation: When somebody waves from across traffic
reactions.response: Darcy waits at the corner to hear their voice and give them a proper answer.
reactions.asWritten: When somebody waves from across traffic, Darcy waits at the corner to hear their voice and give them a proper answer.
